card: ROLE: Named robot character; participant in a single robot conversation sequence
TRAIT: Initially rejects Aghora's pregnancy as impossible because it contradicts his model of Aghora as the galaxy's greatest warrior and a symbol of masculinity
TRAIT: Can be rebuked or argued into conceding; yields when directly challenged to accept an unwanted fact
RELATIONSHIP: tonto (Tonto): named interlocutor in the same robot conversation sequence; present during the exchange about Aghora's auto-conception via hypo-genetics
VOICE: Resistant when new information conflicts with a strongly held prior; concession is spoken and blunt; does not elaborate once yielded
BOUNDARY: No confirmed backstory, earlier role, later activity, authority, broader knowledge, or motive beyond the conversation about Aghora's pregnancy
